recommendation: Keep the commit. It completes the applied correction across the active ImplementationGuide profile elements and removes the remaining example-only description that could mislead users of manifest.resource.profile.
issue_request: FHIR-44784 was an Applied FHIR-core ImplementationGuide change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It requested changing the profile short text from "Profile(s) this is an example of" to "Profile(s) this resource is valid against" and replacing the example-only comment with wording covering profiles expected to be valid for example and non-example resources.
initial_application: Jira records application in git commit 3d93b0b026. That commit changed ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.profile in the active source file, but left the parallel ImplementationGuide.manifest.resource.profile element with the same obsolete short and example-only comment.
additional_context: ImplementationGuide is active in source/fhir.ini and the StructureDefinition source contains both definition.resource.profile and manifest.resource.profile. FHIR-I minutes for 2024-03-25 record the rationale that profiles can govern non-example infrastructure/canonical resources, supporting the same wording on the manifest profile element. Searches found no separate manifest issue or conflicting Zulip discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/implementationguide/structuredefinition-ImplementationGuide.xml so ImplementationGuide.manifest.resource.profile uses the same short and comment already applied to ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.profile.

related_jiras.note: Introduced the ImplementationGuide isExample/profile split whose definition and manifest profile elements both inherited example-oriented wording. It was not independently reconciled here.
